title: KoALa-Bench: Evaluating Large Audio Language Models on Korean Speech Understanding and Faithfulness
abstract: arXiv:2604.19782v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent advances in large audio language models (LALMs) have enabled multilingual speech understanding. However, benchmarks for evaluating LALMs remain scarce for non-English languages, with Korean being one such underexplored case. In this paper, we introduce KoALa-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating Korean speech understanding and speech faithfulness of LALMs. In particular, KoALa-Bench comprises six tasks. Four tasks evaluate fundamental speech understanding capabilities, including automatic speech recognition, speech translation, speech question answering, and speech instruction following, while the remaining two tasks evaluate speech faithfulness, motivated by our observation that several LALMs often fail to fully leverage the speech modality. translated_title: KoALa-Bench：评估大型音频语言模型在韩语语音理解与忠实度上的表现
translated_abstract: 近年来，大型音频语言模型（LALMs）的进展使得多语言语音理解成为可能。然而，用于评估LALMs的基准在非英语语言中仍然稀缺，韩语便是其中未被充分探索的语言之一。在本文中，我们提出了KoALa-Bench，这是一个用于评估LALMs韩语语音理解能力和语音忠实度的综合基准。具体而言，KoALa-Bench包含六项任务：其中四项任务评估基础语音理解能力，包括自动语音识别、语音翻译、语音问答和语音指令跟随；另外两项任务评估语音忠实度，这一设计源于我们的观察——多个LALMs往往未能充分利用语音模态。此外，为了反映韩国特有的知识，我们的基准纳入了韩国大学入学考试（高考）的听力题以及涵盖韩国相关内容的数据。
tldr: 本文提出KoALa-Bench，这是一个包含六项任务、用于评估大型音频语言模型韩语语音理解与语音忠实度的综合基准，并纳入韩国高考听力题等韩国特有知识。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces KoALa-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark comprising six tasks for evaluating Korean speech understanding and speech faithfulness of large audio language models, incorporating Korea-specific knowledge such as CSAT listening questions.
